WITH
    PassesWithTeams AS (
        SELECT
            p.pass_from,
            p.pass_to,
            t1.team_name AS team_from,
            t2.team_name AS team_to,
            IF(t1.team_name = t2.team_name, 1, 0) same_team_flag,
            p.time_stamp
        FROM
            Passes p
            JOIN Teams t1 ON p.pass_from = t1.player_id
            JOIN Teams t2 ON p.pass_to = t2.player_id
    ),
    StreakGroups AS (
        SELECT
            team_from AS team_name,
            time_stamp,
            same_team_flag,
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN same_team_flag = 0 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) OVER (
                PARTITION BY team_from
                ORDER BY time_stamp
            ) AS group_id
        FROM PassesWithTeams
    ),
    StreakLengths AS (
        SELECT
            team_name,
            group_id,
            COUNT(*) AS streak_length
        FROM StreakGroups
        WHERE same_team_flag = 1
        GROUP BY 1, 2
    ),
    LongestStreaks AS (
        SELECT
            team_name,
            MAX(streak_length) AS longest_streak
        FROM StreakLengths
        GROUP BY 1
    )
SELECT
    team_name,
    longest_streak
FROM LongestStreaks
ORDER BY 1;
title: Longest Team Pass Streak
